speaker: Doctor
text: Dr. Agent: Thank you for the details. To better understand your scalp and forehead rash, can you describe its onset and any associated symptoms like itching, pain, or fever? Also, have you noticed any changes in your hair or scalp texture?

speaker: Patient
text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. The patient was born at 36 weeks' gestation and has been generally healthy since. The patient's father has a history of psoriasis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Infantile seborrheic dermatitis (cradle cap) exacerbated by weather; psoriasis is a differential given the family history, but the age and chronicity favor seborrheic dermatitis. REQUEST IMAGES: Scalp close-up showing if the scales are greasy/yellow (seborrheic) or silvery/thick (psoriatic).
